channel.title: Portfolio on Chelsea Suddens
channel.description: Recent content in Portfolio on Chelsea Suddens

item.title: Castle Adventure Chess
item.description: Castle Adventure Chess is a chess learning app for kids ages 5–12, made by Tripwire Tech. It turns chess into a kingdom quest — children learn by playing, not by sitting through long lessons.

item.title: Maths For Kids
item.description: Maths For Kids is a maths games and practice app for children aged about 5 to 8, made by Tripwire Tech. It helps young learners build real number confidence through short, playful games — not worksheets.

item.title: Revenue Tap
item.description: Revenue Tap is a local-first publisher analytics app made by Tripwire Tech. It puts AdMob, AdSense, Google Play, App Store Connect, and Google Analytics on one dashboard so you can review ads, store proceeds, installs, and usage without jumping between consoles.

item.title: Lawn Bowls Diary
item.description: Lawn Bowls Diary is a lawn bowls scoring and statistics app made by Tripwire Tech. It is a training and match journal for the green — built for bowlers who want clearer practice, better game notes, and progress you can see.

item.title: Speed Puzzling Diary
item.description: Speed Puzzling Diary is a speed puzzling timer and training tracker made by Tripwire Tech. Plan practices, run timed drills, log rounds, and see what actually makes you faster.

item.title: Curling Diary
item.description: Curling Diary is a curling scorekeeping and statistics app made by Tripwire Tech. It is built for curlers who want a proper game tracker and practice journal — not scattered notes in a generic notebook app.
